body: Quick reply - will follow up properly tomorrow.\n\n- Joyce
subject: Re: Weekly status doc

body:
Stefan, thank you for the imaging proofs.

They look excellent. Let us walk through Margarethe's notes on the Schiele sheets on Monday before we send anything to the ministry.

- Joyce
subject: Re: Digitisation Phase 2 proofs

body:
Margarethe, one thought on the Vienna Modern hang.

Could we open with the Secession room rather than the portraits? I think it sets the tone better. Happy to discuss in the walkthrough.

- Joyce
subject: Vienna Modern - opening sequence

body:
Lena, mi amor -

Are you still coming home for the opening weekend in October? Papá wants to book the train. Let me know your dates when you can.

Besos, Mamá
subject: October visit?

body:
Dr. Sommer, thank you for chairing Thursday's session.

I'll circulate the revised strategy figures before the next board meeting. Please let me know if the finance appendix needs anything further.

Best, Joyce
subject: Re: Board strategy review

body:
Felix, did you decide on the Bartók or the Schubert for the audition?

Either way I'd love to hear you run it once before Sunday. Proud of you.

- Mamá
subject: Audition piece

body:
Petra, thank you for the conservation report.

Before we return the Klimt drawings to store, could we confirm the humidity readings from the imaging studio? I want the record complete for the grant file.

- Joyce
subject: Klimt drawings - condition record

body:
Christoph, a quick note on the development plan.

Can we schedule the patrons' preview for the week before the public opening? I'd like Heinrich to say a few words. Let's find a date.

- Joyce
subject: Patrons' preview - Vienna Modern

body:
Mamá, ¿cómo estás?

Catalina told me about the appointment. Please call me tonight after dinner - I want to hear how it went. Te quiero.

- Joyce
subject: Llamada esta noche

body:
To the Minister's office -

Thank you for the invitation. I confirm my attendance at the cultural policy roundtable and will bring the digitisation briefing note as requested.

Kind regards, Dr. Joyce Padilla
subject: Re: Cultural policy roundtable

body:
Matthias, I'm running late at the museum - the loan call went long.

Could you start dinner without me? I'll be home by eight. Grüner Veltliner is in the fridge.

- J
subject: Running late

body:
Beatrix, could you pull the accession numbers for the Prague loan objects?

Stefan needs them for the insurance schedule by Friday. Thank you.

- Joyce
subject: Prague loan - accession numbers

body:
Julia, here is the approved wording for the Vienna Modern press release.

Please hold the embargo until the patrons' preview. Let's review the photo selection together on Monday.

- Joyce
subject: Press release - sign-off

body:
Catalina, gracias por cuidar a Mamá esta semana.

I'll come to Graz the first weekend I can get free. Let me know if she needs anything before then.

Un abrazo, Joyce
subject: Graz este mes

body:
Stefan, please add the EU heritage milestone update to Friday's agenda.

I'd like the board to see we are on schedule for the March 2027 deadline. Draft figures attached to follow.

- Joyce
subject: Board agenda - digitisation milestone

body:
Dr. Sommer, a note ahead of the EMYA jury discussion.

I've drafted our nomination summary and would value your view before I submit. Are you free for a short call Wednesday?

Best, Joyce
subject: EMYA nomination - draft

body:
Matthias, I booked us a table at Gasthaus Wickerl for Saturday at eight.

It's been too long since we had an evening to ourselves. Wear the grey jacket I like.

- J
subject: Saturday dinner

body:
Christoph, can we review the sponsorship figures before I meet the board finance subgroup?

I want the Vienna Modern budget to reconcile cleanly. Thursday morning works my end.

- Joyce
subject: Sponsorship figures - review

body:
Lena, I finished the García Márquez you lent me - extraordinary.

Bring the Allende when you visit and we'll talk about both over café de olla. Papá says hola.

- Mamá
subject: El libro

body:
Margarethe, the Paris loan wording is settled.

Could you confirm the final wall-text credits for the Musée des Arts Modernes pieces? We can then send the catalogue to the printer.

- Joyce
subject: Catalogue - final credits
